files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
### Fixed
- **Balanced left/right table edge spacing, clean Select All checkbox styling and pointer cursor, wider Preview column, Select All button toggle, and hover highlights/tooltips** ([#206](https://github.com/eldertek/duplicatefinder/issues/206)). Balanced the horizontal spacing between the left table edge and the first checkbox with the right table edge and the far-right delete button (`172px` action column for 4-button rows and `130px` for 3-button rows with `box-sizing: border-box`), removed the dark native outline around the top-left Select All checkbox so all checkboxes share identical custom styling and a `pointer` cursor on hover, widened the `Preview` column (`92px`) for balanced spacing before the `Name & Path` divider, made clicking the `Select All` button a second time toggle selection off, unified hover border highlights on the green `Acknowledge` (`<button>`) and red `Delete` buttons, and added instant hover tooltips (`data-tooltip`) on all icon-only action buttons
